title: The Nine say they are behind nuclear-base sightings

tellings.quote: Uh they kind of say like we're kind of behind a lot of the sightings that that are occurring at nuclear bases.

plain: In the 1970s a group calling itself the Nine, presented as a council of nonhuman beings who spoke through recorded sessions, supposedly said that "we're kind of behind a lot of the sightings" at nuclear bases. An unnamed researcher tells Michels this, drawing on tapes of the sessions made by a man named Puharich. If true, it would mean the UFOs reported over nuclear weapons sites had a deliberate source that owned up to them.
